To complete the challenge, fill the grid using the digits 1 through 9, ensuring that each digit appears exactly once in every row, column, and 3×3 subsection, while thinking about climate considerations and the role of gas in everyday life.

When you are ready to check your solution, purchase next week’s Observer Digital Edition to view the completed puzzle, a temporary twist that adds excitement to the routine.

Finally, consider the weight of your effort as you work through the numbers, knowing that each step brings you closer to mastery."
